title: Multi-Mode Card Framework
subtitle: Modular Unity card framework for Blackjack, Solitaire, and Texas Hold'em with WebGL and Meta Quest 3 delivery.
challenge: Designing a single Unity codebase that supports WebGL, desktop, and XR while keeping gameplay logic pure C# and deterministic enough for automated testing. The project separates Core, Presentation, Cloud, and Input/XR layers, then uses dependency injection and platform adapters so one rules engine can run across multiple device contexts without coupling gameplay logic to Unity scene objects.
architecture: Built around layered architecture with a pure Core domain model, event-driven controllers, and explicit adapters for platform-specific systems. The project applies Dependency Injection, modular game engines, UI Toolkit presentation, and PlayFab-backed services to keep the rules layer reusable and the presentation layer interchangeable.
